Due to temperamental issues, the Petitioner/husband and the Respondent No. 2 are residing separately since 23.01.2024.
5.

It is stated that the Complainant had lodged a complaint before the CAW Cell against the Petitioners, which culminated into registration of FIR No. 0420/2024 dated 08.07.2024 under Sections 354/354(A)/354(B)/506 IPC at P.S. Jagat Puri.
6. It is submitted that as per the FIR, the alleged incident happened in January, 2024 while the FIR was registered in July, 2024.
Essentially, this FIR has emanated from the matrimonial dispute and the Petitioners are none other than husband and father-in-law of the Complainant.

Not only this,
complaint in CAW Cell had also been filed for registration of FIR under Section 498A IPC against the Petitioner/husband and other family members.
7. In terms of the Settlement, the Statements of the parties have already been recorded before the learned JR.
8. The parties are present before this Court in-person today and have been identified by their learned counsel and Investigating Officer.
9. It is only with the intervention of the Mediation Centre that the matter is ultimately settled vide Mediation Settlement dated 18.11.2024.

The parties have now amicably settled their disputes and thus the Petition has been filed for quashing of FIR.
10.

12. The parties have endorsed the amicable settlement and accepted the terms thereof voluntarily.
The parties have undertaken to remain bound by the terms of the Settlement.

The parties have submitted that all the disputes have been amicably settled vide Mediation Settlement dated 18.11.2024 and thus, no fruitful purpose will be served in continuing with the FIR.
13.

14. Though there are allegations of sexual assault made against the father-in-law/Petitioner No. 2 but essentially, it is an outcome of the matrimonial dispute, which is now stands settled, no fruitful purpose would be served in continuing with the FIR.
